title: [kvm][configdb] After building a KVM, a deprecated field still exist /VLAN/Vlan1000/members
author: ghooo
body:
#### Description
After building a KVM, config-db has a field that should deprecated/revmoved:
/VLAN/Vlan1000/members

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Build up a KVM env
2. `show running-config all`
3. look for `members` under `/VLAN/Vlan1000`

comments.author: ghooo
comments.body: @qiluo-msft I think it is a pain point for E2E testing of generic-config-updater. We do a work around by removing the `members` from the config using `config reload`. It is an inconvenience, I think it should be fixed.
